name: Amane
source:
Having led a sheltered life, Amane is interested in learning about the outside world; the only thing stopping her from doing so being self-doubt. She has a gentle personality, and because she's shy and lacks confidence in herself, Amane can be a little nervous around customers. If the protagonist shows interest in movies, however, she'll follow along the conversation with a smile.

[spoiler]Her real name is Shirogane Misaki (白金 岬).[/spoiler]
